target.purpose: Replace scattered role checks with an explicit, auditable, default-deny object-type/verb authority matrix.
target.central_bottleneck: Consequential systems become unsafe when unfamiliar object/action combinations inherit authority implicitly or wildcard grants cannot be distinguished from exact grants.
success: Exact and wildcard grants are distinguished in the authorization decision.
The matched grant is bound into the decision fingerprint.
Malformed grants are rejected at construction.
Authorization remains separate from execution, lineage validation, and writeback.

invariants: wildcard authority identifies the exact matched wildcard rule
malformed request dimensions refuse without throwing open
authorization decisions are deterministic and auditable
this mechanism does not execute the authorized action

donor_plan.basis: The current repository owns the object-type/verb authority mechanism; sibling lineage and writeback systems remain separate composition targets.

evolution.composition_gate: Do not bind to lineage or writeback siblings until executable receipt-to-receipt integration proof exists.

nonclaims: not a production Palantir authorization service
no property-level authorization is currently implemented
no external identity authentication is currently implemented
no exercised integration with action-lineage or writeback sibling repositories
